part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `to_json` for enums in both `include/nlohmann/detail/conversions/to_json.hpp:361` and the mirrored `single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp:5738`: enums were always constructed as `number_integer`, even when the underlying type is unsigned. The fix uses `std::conditional` on `std::is_unsigned<underlying_type>` to build the value as `number_unsigned` for unsigned underlying types, so e.g. `book_id : uint64_t` with `1 << 63` now serializes as `9223372036854775808` and `is_number_unsigned()` returns true.

Verified: `test-udt_cpp11` (which contains the FAIL_TO_PASS large-id checks) plus conversions, serialization, constructor1/2, meta, type_traits, comparison, and regression2 tests (cpp11/17/20) all pass.
